# N10: Talk-path polish: search by key, Home counts that open their goals, teams worst first, one rule for a decision waiting, the Board’s own status, phone wrapping and targets

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/10-talk-polish.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

the talk-path polish (deep review, 10 Nov; Lane approved 9 Nov, before the talk on 11 Nov). run({ open, url }) returns a list of failures. One check per finding: U28 Goals search finds a goal by its key, however it is typed ("G-48", "g48", "48"), and a key finds only its goal. U23 Home's counts by status each open their own filtered Goals list, and the list holds that many goals. U24 By team gives each team its goals counted by status (shape and word) and lists the teams worst first. U25 "Decision or help needed" names the same goals in the saved view, the Table's story lines and Home's ask. U27 On a phone, what someone asked of you in Needs your response wraps to two lines, never cut mid-word. D2 Every Board card leads with its own status, a shape and its word, the same as its lane. D3 Set-up's small links (Start over, Change, Change people) are 44px to hit on a phone.
